      public static void applyHoverScaling(javafx.scene.Node node)
      Applies two animations. When the node is being hovered the node's scale property goes to 1.05. When the node was hovered and is no longer being hovered the node's scale property returns to 1.
      Parameters:
      node - the node to be scaled
